context.content: I'm Canadian, $15 USD a month converts to \~$20/mnth and that's too much for alpha-level software that hasn't even figured out a proper offline-mode and mobile app like every other cloud based note taking software out there. I liked the back-linking, found the graphs completely useless, didn't even dare to try and put it on my phone, and the icon for the 'desktop app' needed more work. I also get the cultivating a cult is some kind of "what the kids are doing for marketing these days" but I found it distasteful and it's a turn-off to continuing the subscription. For god's sakes, just be a mature boring web app. I'll keep on eye on it and might revisit in the future once the software matures, but for now it's not worth it for me.
